top_signals.title: Crude oil prices and refinery margins generally increased throughout the third quarter
top_signals.summary: Petroleum markets in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26) were characterized by increasing prices for crude oil and petroleum products amid persistent conflict in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Kalshi Files Proposal for Never-Expiring Oil Contract With CFTC
top_signals.summary: Kalshi Inc. has filed a proposal for an oil-linked futures contract that never expires with the Commodity Futures Trading Commission, according to the company.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
